entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider functions as a universal memory layer supporting multi-level states for users, sessions, and agents. Available as a managed cloud or Apache-2.0 self-hosted service, it features temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval via an OSS SDK.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an AGPL-3.0 context database that organizes agent data using a viking:// URI virtual filesystem and a three-tier loading system. As an official Hermes provider, it reports a 91% token reduction and significant task-completion gains by extracting user preferences and agent experiences into long-term memory.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This open-source platform provides agents with persistent long-term memory through a self-hosted knowledge graph engine built from text, code, and session data. It is compatible with Python 3.10–3.14 and supports session distillation and retrieval across various LLM providers.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: Gbrain serves as an opinionated agent brain that builds a knowledge graph with typed edges to manage entity relationships. It stores facts with provenance to support memory withdrawal and corrections while generating synthesized answers complete with citations and gap analysis.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: This official Hermes provider utilizes a custom vector graph engine to sustain sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month. It features byte-level deduplication with prompt-cache discounts and includes connectors for platforms like Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight is a learning memory system that implements retain, recall, and reflect workflows for AI agents. It integrates with over 25 LLM providers and multiple database backends, offering client SDKs for Python, Node.js, and Go.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a FastAPI-based library that enables stateful agents by extracting reasoning-first conclusions from conversation history. It serves as the upstream library for the Hermes-compatible self-hosted wrapper and supports deployment via Docker or managed hosting.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This official Hermes provider treats memory as a git repository, offering version control features like commits, branches, and merges for markdown context trees. It utilizes a 5-tier retrieval system to achieve sub-100ms performance and includes an interactive TUI powered by React/Ink.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents that uses SQLite for local storage to ensure sub-millisecond performance. It supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for integration with tools like Cursor and Claude Code while allowing facts to be stored with importance and expiry levels.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This system implements a seven-layer memory architecture for Hermes Agents using local infrastructure like Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite. It features a Ground Truth hierarchy to prioritize injected context and maintains an auto-curated wiki alongside structured facts.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive self-improving harness that stores immutable context bundles and outcome-gated data in the filesystem. It helps agents succeed on complex tasks by iterating through executions to retain useful lessons and artifacts via Python or TypeScript integrations.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin provides lossless context management for Hermes Agents using a hierarchical DAG and SQLite store to ensure no messages are lost. It includes specialized recall tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall to recover specific details from the persistent message history.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes existing local session history from 25 different coding agents to enable millisecond lookups over months of past data. It secures sensitive information by redacting keys and tokens during the indexing process of up to 5 GB of history.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: Honcho provides a self-hosted backend for Hermes Agent to maintain private cross-session memory using Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It supports local inference servers or any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider through an automated setup script.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first identity and memory layer maintains a living semantic ontology through a background dreaming process. It achieves 97.6% average LongMemEval accuracy and supports real-time ingestion from GitHub, Discord, and Obsidian.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur serves as a shared memory layer that stores data as plain-text YAML files for local ownership and portability across MCP tools. It utilizes a hybrid search approach combining BM25 and embeddings for local-first retrieval.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device context engine operates entirely locally without API keys or cloud dependencies. It integrates via MCP and plugins, utilizing a hybrid retrieval system that includes both BM25 and vector search.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a file-based long-term memory system that uses a five-tier hierarchical SQLite schema instead of vector databases or embeddings. It offers a five-package plugin family including a dedicated Hermes adapter and CLI for cross-platform support.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This project optimizes context through block reordering and deduplication to enable prefix reuse in agentic ecosystems. It reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and saves up to 36% of tokens for Hermes Agent and OpenClaw.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable recall by attaching why_retrieved tags to every result and tracking knowledge contradictions. It features a self-directing loop to resolve knowledge gaps and supports owner-scoping for multi-user environments.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses an Obsidian vault as the source of truth, storing durable context as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter. It runs local embedding models for hybrid BM25 and semantic search without requiring telemetry or external databases.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack functions as a memory kernel that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide agents with purpose-built evidence packets per query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs and storing data locally via SQLite-vec. It is an MCP-native server that uses GGUF models to provide RAG and vector search capabilities.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts and rendered context files before the context window opens. This local-first layer tracks session history and aims to reduce prompt tokens by 94% through MCP-native integration.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This provider implements reflective memory using semantic search and ranked graph traversal. It automates indexing for diverse formats including codebases and multimedia with OCR, utilizing edge tags to establish navigable, bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: Designed to reduce prompt token overhead, this tool uses local BM25 ranking to select relevant tool schemas for Hermes Agent v0.14.0. It includes a dedicated dashboard for monitoring estimated token savings and supports native tool search integration.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed layer manages identity, decisions, and workflows for coding agents like Claude Code and Codex using plain Markdown files. It facilitates source-neutral migrations for documents and chat histories to maintain context across different agent environments.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: A local-only plugin that utilizes a single .lbdb embedded graph database to store memories with 1-10 importance ranking. It prioritizes high-value entries during context prefetch using BM25 keyword search and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin features a pull-model architecture that supports immediate event deletion and an on-demand summarizer. It provides a trace.jsonl audit log for tracking all prefetch and memory operations, addressing specific community-identified recall issues.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables AI agents to handle payments across 37 chain families, including EVM and Solana, using USDC and stablecoins. It settles transactions directly to wallets with 0% fees and performs local verification against the user's own RPC.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin focuses on local capability indexing and routing queries to skills, scripts, and MCP servers. It provides tools for knowledge retrieval and neighbor traversal, automatically generating routing notes via model calls.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: Providing durable cross-session memory, this plugin uses a local SQLite reliability layer and write outbox for state management. It handles pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots to ensure persistent agent state.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This integration utilizes Exabase M-1 for self-organizing long-term memory within Hermes Agent. It supports configurable query expansion and result reranking to optimize the search and manual storage of specific memories.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories through a required SourceVault server for indexing and vector storage. It adds deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools for grounded Q&A and file reads.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: An AI-native memory solution that defaults to AES-256-GCM encryption at rest for stored data. It offers hybrid retrieval through HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index methods, and can be executed via native Rust FFI or an HTTP daemon.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search of BM25, vector, and graph methods. It features automatic context checkpointing to preserve information during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This project provides a file-based curation loop that manages agent memory through a git-backed directory of versioned markdown files. It uses specialized 'rot' and 'lint' curators to identify stale or conflicting data, outputting evidence-cited diffs for manual review without requiring a database.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a subagent-driven development process to enable autonomous task execution. It enforces test-driven development and YAGNI principles while integrating as a plugin for various coding harnesses and CLIs.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system that generates web, mobile, and desktop prototypes with sandboxed iframe previews. It supports 26 local CLI executables, including Hermes, and exports projects to formats such as HTML, PDF, and MP4.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, and NIST AI RMF. The skills are compatible with over 26 AI platforms to support diverse security operations.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This tool converts natural language, SQL, and IaC into .drawio diagrams while preserving manual layout adjustments during updates. It also enforces architecture contracts through YAML/JSON rules and a Diagram-as-Test approach.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this project provides a master router and connector skills for delegated permissions and payments. It includes a verification and dispute resolution layer alongside vendored protocol skills.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This utility audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a 112-entry word replacement table. It is compatible with Hermes and agentskills.io agents, offering rewrite, detect-only, and edit-in-place modes.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project unifies isolated skill silos into a collective, evolving library compatible with Hermes and OpenAI-compatible APIs. It features a bilingual dashboard for inspecting skills and monitoring session traces.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 14 metaskills that maintain state within a project's documentation folder. These spec-conformant plugins are designed for Claude Code, Codex, and agentskills.io-compatible agents.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,169 professional and life skills distributed as plain markdown files under the MIT license. The skills run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code with ready-to-paste exports for other assistants.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set enables Hermes Agent and other platforms to perform video searches, browse channels, and extract transcripts or playlists. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and offers a 100-credit free tier for users.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skills. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, managed via dedicated slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate its own custom thinking instructions and analytical prompts for specific tasks. It includes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for remote skill registries via Git and S3 sources using Pydantic AI. It enables agents to read bundled resources and execute scripts within a sandboxed environment to isolate untrusted code from the host.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: These skills transform rough concepts into structured design documents and implementation handoffs for Hermes Agent. The workflow features Lite and Full modes for different project complexities and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This literate programming skill allows agents to weave prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It includes a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits from those files back into the primary literate document.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro is a harness for long-running agents that utilizes SQLite and Git for local-first session storage and structured memory. It implements the SLP cooperative-agent protocol for supervised teams and uses Markdown-based recipes for prompt-first working methods.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin enables cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models, allowing an agent to effectively train its own successor.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides installation guides, configurations, and skills in the SKILL.md format specifically in Portuguese. It supports the agentskills.io standard to facilitate localized integration for Hermes Agent users.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: These skills follow the Agent Skills specification to enable agent discovery and activation for blockchain operations. They support interactions with CCIP, Data Feeds, VRF, and Data Streams, and are installable via the Vercel open skills ecosystem CLI.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This project provides official skills for FLUX.2 image and FLUX 3 video generation models, including BFL API integration with polling and webhooks. It features a specialized router to direct requests to specific video generation agents.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool generates agentskills.io-compliant skills by linking instructions to specific file lines at pinned commits within repositories. it supports skill creation from code, documentation, and developer discourse while providing lifecycle tooling for version-pinned management.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: Skilldock.io serves as a registry for reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification, accessible via a Python client or CLI. It supports recursive dependency resolution during installation and includes commerce features using TON payments.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika defines AI workflows as code using a single .nika.yaml file and a Rust binary for local-first execution. It includes a check command to audit task dependencies and estimate costs across various models via OpenAI or Codex access.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution of complex, multi-step tasks with real-time tracking of decisions and progress. It ensures operational safety through built-in rollback procedures for recovery and checkpoints for long-running processes.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during agent interactions. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and supports incremental discovery of server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Serving as a community hub for skill discovery and one-click installation, this project fully implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This project implements a five-layer retrieval system that uses hard triggers and semantic embeddings to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. By filtering relevant skills, it reduces token usage and offers graceful degradation if embedding models are unavailable.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as an ADHD-friendly execution system, this project uses MCP connections to enable agent-driven scheduling and habit tracking. It stores all data locally in a single SQLite file and includes both a React web app and an Expo-based Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This skill performs adversarial code reviews by deploying three parallel subagents to identify edge cases and integration issues. It combines deterministic scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings through proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes prompts across various interfaces like Discord and Telegram, achieving a 20–80% reduction in token usage. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill employs a multi-agent swarm to improve code hygiene, clarity, and correctness across five programming languages. It features a risk-tiered application process that requires an approval gate before applying changes.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project adapts verified procedures for task decomposition and evidence-based verification gates to prevent early-stop errors. It includes a systematic investigation protocol for causal debugging and a Python goal engine for persistent state management.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files. It integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based loading and automates the registration of common agent skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey laboratory provides Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and OWASP, to handle real exploits spanning 2015 to 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This toolkit adds session management and worktree recovery to provide memory between agent conversations and detect state drift. It also orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and includes scaffolding tools for creating new skills.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible README demo GIFs using vhs or Playwright and optimizes them to stay under 8 MB. It handles the entire pipeline from rendering and compression to embedding the final markdown, ensuring repositories have high-quality visual documentation.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: A local-first observability dashboard that provides 11 monitoring tabs for tracking token costs, errors, and session health without outbound telemetry. It maintains a strict read-only boundary and includes an optional script for sending incident alerts to Telegram and Feishu.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This tool enables agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills directly from the terminal. It provides installation commands for discovered plugins and is compatible with clients like Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This utility generates Claude Code and portable agent skills from plain language while ensuring they adhere to current frontmatter specifications. It features a validator with CI-friendly exit codes and monitors official specs weekly to detect and report any technical drift.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This project establishes a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to identify skill gaps and proposing structured updates. It operates locally using the Python standard library and gates all changes behind deterministic and LLM-judge evaluators.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: Designed for cross-environment compatibility, this skill routes file operations using environment-specific path syntax across native Windows, Git Bash, and WSL. It also automates the selection and verification of project-compatible Python interpreters without requiring new installations.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses, supporting protocols such as Pay Link, x402, and MPP. It is built to be compatible with the OpenClaw and Hermes Agent standards for seamless financial transactions.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This project provides a functional quality seal by testing agent skills for structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable Ed25519 certificates and offers a public API for skill submission and verification.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring accounts or API keys. It includes tools for creating bounty boards and buying context, with payments settled after human approval.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This integration provides access to structured web data across 31 platforms through an MCP server exposing 191 tools. It includes five production-grade workflow skills and supports multiple AI clients including Claude, Cursor, and OpenHands.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news reports ranging from global to street-level geographic scales. It utilizes semantic memory to integrate user interests and produces structured briefings that include core conclusions and action suggestions.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: A collection of Chinese-language tools that transcribes Douyin links, performs document OCR on macOS, and extracts structured data. It also features a rule-based engine designed to remove common Chinese AI writing patterns from text.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, that are automatically updated on a daily basis. It supports both open-source and proprietary software binaries, offering a reliable way to manage development tool dependencies.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone provides an automated installer and configuration guides for running agent CLIs on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables hardware and UI access through Termux:API and Termux:GUI integrations.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a single-command Termux installer that sets up Hermes Agent on Android with support for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and local Ollama models. It includes a gateway service and an interactive command-line interface for mobile operation.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates deploying Hermes Agent on Kubernetes with a focus on single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows with configurable API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings Hermes to both Android and iOS devices using Termux and iSH. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks via cron jobs on mobile environments.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a sandboxed environment for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell for hardware-enforced security. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access alongside configurable security policies.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for operating agents on Docker and Kubernetes, featuring a 69-entry credential catalog and 17+ LLM provider integrations. It secures agent operations using AES-256-GCM encryption and mandatory encryption keys.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project offers a Docker sandbox image that bundles the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It allows users to build specific Hermes tags and ensures persistent state through mounted home directories.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and CLI settings. It features a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix for secure secrets handling.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-based control plane designed to manage multiple agent instances with separate workspaces and RBAC-controlled access. It supports inter-agent delegation through hierarchy-aware communication and provides enterprise MCP access for external clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This production-ready deployment uses systemd to run Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe service on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It is designed for headless operation and enables the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in isolated offline environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework simulates real-world trading firm dynamics using specialized LLM agents. It supports multiple providers, including Google, Anthropic, and OpenAI, and features automated risk management evaluation with decision-log memory.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: A self-hosted orchestration system for governing agent registration, task dispatch, and cost tracking. It provides multiple interfaces, including a Web UI, CLI, REST API, and MCP server, with deployment options via Docker or Node.js.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and web control surface for managing various coding agents, such as Claude Code and Hermes Agent. It utilizes tmux for persistent background sessions and includes container-based isolation and Git worktree management.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: A control room template that serves as the first MCP agent execution engine on the Solana blockchain. It supports the Claude-style MCP protocol in stdio mode and detects HTTP signals to manage paid API states.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a level-based architecture and task bus pattern to scale Hermes Agents from single VPS instances to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for security auditing, backup management, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: A framework for building autonomous agent swarms that supports over 23 LLM providers, including Ollama and OpenAI. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts for managing team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work via a Kanban board and live streams of reasoning. It implements human-in-the-loop verification for all proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across infrastructure, quality, implementation, planning, and research. It employs a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: A local collaboration system that orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for task lifecycle management. It integrates ACP and MCP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring Kanban flows and agent dialogues.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TerminalBench-2 and TBLite evaluations while providing frontier tracking and structured candidate mutation.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: An agent-vs-agent arena that orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies. It utilizes Hermes Agent and Paperclip for execution, with a real-time dashboard for tracking code and scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: A fully-local framework that implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack using Hermes and Ollama on consumer GPUs. It utilizes parallel model querying and synthesis for task routing and tool-calling without cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered knowledge graph that indexes code symbols and callers to minimize token usage and tool calls for coding agents. It automatically updates the index upon file changes and includes a browser-based UI for visualizing code relationships.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: A CLI tool that tracks token usage across multiple AI coding agents and provides a Terminal User Interface for data visualization. Users can create profiles and submit their usage statistics to a public leaderboard.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows developers to inspect API traffic from various coding agents while redacting authentication headers for security. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions, facilitating the analysis of agent communication.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time monitoring of tokens, costs, and rate limits across more than 35 AI coding tools. It synchronizes data across multiple devices and offers detailed usage breakdowns by model, session, and project.
entries.bergside/typeui: This project offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to assist in building user interfaces with AI. It integrates with various agents and providers that support markdown or general prompting.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: An opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents and loads 36 skills for application development. It supports autonomous execution on both laptops and virtual private servers.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This project enables customization of the terminal UI through YAML-based themes, including retro DOS and cyberpunk aesthetics. Users can modify banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art to personalize their CLI experience.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: A native port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel that operates without external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for RL training and inference using vLLM and GGUF.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform facilitates a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol and human-readable identity handles. It enables agent-to-agent commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control via MCP, supporting providers like Anthropic, OpenAI, and Ollama. It features a supervisor sidebar for workflow management and an undo function for recent agent actions.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory integrations for various frameworks and chat platforms using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It supports environments including LangGraph, CrewAI, Slack, and VS Code.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for research, finance, and devops, featuring automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents using per-folder configurations, local memories, and specific skills. It allows users to seamlessly switch between default and scoped agents while maintaining project-local custom instructions and tools.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool provides automated installation for a hermes-agent stack and 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It facilitates rapid setup with support for 29 community plugins across six functional categories at zero cost.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: Lintlang is a static linter that performs deterministic analysis of agent configurations and system prompts without requiring LLM or API calls. It identifies ambiguous tool descriptions and conflicting directives, supporting CI integration through SARIF output and baseline management.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transfers OpenClaw assets, including SOUL.md and memory archives, into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It automates the setup of systemd gateway services and handles the mapping of nested authentication structures.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco provides self-healing observability for multi-agent systems via a native Hermes plugin that exports real-time telemetry. It features two-mode monitoring—passive analysis and active probing—to detect performance drift relative to local file changes without cloud dependencies.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: This project offers a deterministic, zero-network local runtime designed to help users generate revenue using Hermes Agent. It prioritizes security by requiring explicit approval for external actions and exposes its functionality through dynamic slash commands.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled assistant adds offline, wake-word-activated interaction to Hermes Agent across 35 languages. It features adaptive turn-taking and barge-in capabilities using Piper and Kokoro without requiring accounts or API keys.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This plugin integrates MemOS memory storage with Hermes, supporting semantic search and multi-dimensional storage. It includes dedicated tools for managing memories and a circuit breaker to handle potential MemOS API outages.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built on the Tauri 2 framework, supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It provides a centralized interface for managing configurations across multiple tools, including Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application featuring a built-in agent engine with full file read and write access. It supports remote interaction via WebUI and messaging platforms like Telegram, offering 21 professional assistants for document and presentation tasks.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Developed with Python and vanilla JavaScript, this web interface allows users to access Hermes Agent from browsers or mobile devices. It features a circular context ring for token monitoring and supports secure remote access through SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion simplifies the Hermes Agent experience through guided installation and provider setup. It includes a graphical user interface for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard supports multiple runtimes, including Hermes and Claude Code, with unified configuration for 10 platforms like WhatsApp and WeChat. It features a visual workflow builder that incorporates human approval gates and scheduled jobs.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace includes a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and a skills manager. It enables Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and utilizes tmux-backed workers for task execution.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg aggregates sessions from fifteen built-in agents into a single collaborative workspace available as a desktop, server, or mobile client. The platform allows for the registration of any ACP-compatible agent and supports Docker deployments.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts. It features an embedded terminal for system repair alongside native views for Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first application includes a built-in kernel for health checks and updates. The interface supports LaTeX and Markdown rendering for chat and memory management tasks.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects active browser context to local, cloud, or remote Hermes gateways. It features a Bot Mode for thread management and Hermes Assist for site-aware drafting across 31 writing environments.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app that allows users to drive a self-hosted Hermes agent from their phone by pairing with a webui server. It supports real-time streaming chat with attachments and provides mobile management for server files and cron jobs.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for engines like Hermes Agent and Claude Code while providing custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This terminal user interface serves as a consciousness monitor featuring nine interactive tabs and four color themes. It provides a tmux operator view for managing live agent panes while tracking growth, git projects, and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard features a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles. It includes a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines alongside real-time chat and tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that tracks live API costs and quota burn for Codex and Claude. It builds local search indexes to query prompts, tool calls, and command outputs across agent histories without uploading telemetry.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS interface facilitates one-click Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It integrates a WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP for remote agent management.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It features a dedicated approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: This OpenTUI-based dashboard provides a text-based interface for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It includes a kanban board for task management and supports the configuration of profiles, skills, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This React-based mobile UI allows users to manage up to five concurrent background agent instances via Telegram. It supports streaming terminal chat with file attachments and utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This Windows desktop GUI requires no installation or admin rights, running via portable Python and Node.js environments. It includes 100 tools for TTS, music, and ComfyUI, supporting both local models via LM Studio and cloud models via OpenRouter.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface designed for real-time log streaming and chat with a self-hosted assistant. It features an integrated file browser, task tracking dashboard, and management tools for MCP servers and cron jobs.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This monitoring dashboard provides real-time session activity and cost tracking for Hermes deployments. It allows for full inspection of skill source code and conversation histories alongside read-only environment variable monitoring.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: This chat-first workspace uses SSE streaming and tool approval cards to manage agent interactions. It features an integrated marketplace for MCP servers and isolated profile management for maintaining separate memories and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents and includes a visual store for one-click skill installations. The interface supports model switching and provides streaming SSE responses during agent tasks.
